mcp.instructions:
recall: offline fuzzy recall over local VS Code / GitHub Copilot Chat history (everything stays on this machine).
Usage: call search_sessions with a phrase from memory (returns snippets, session_id and turn), then read_session to read a full session or one turn.
The index comes from the last `recall collect` run; sessions never collected are not present.
Privacy: projects excluded in recall.config.json are filtered server-side and never appear in any result.
mcp.tool.search.desc: Fuzzy recall over local VS Code / Copilot Chat history (substring semantics). Returns matching snippets, session_id, turn index, project and date. Best for "I think we discussed some plan once" recalls. Returns up to 20 hits (default 5); projects excluded by the privacy policy never appear.
mcp.tool.read.desc: Read a historical session. Without `turn` it returns session metadata and a directory of user messages; with `turn` it returns that turn's user/assistant text (bounded by max_chars, truncation is marked). Excluded sessions and missing sessions return the same error.
mcp.err.config: failed to load the privacy config ({0}); access denied — fix recall.config.json and retry.
mcp.err.no_session: session not found. (wrong id, or not indexed — try search_sessions or run `recall collect`)
mcp.result.none: no hits. Tip: try a shorter or longer phrase (>=3 chars uses the index, shorter scans everything); if the index is old, run `recall collect` first.
mcp.read.more: …{0} more turn(s) not listed (use the turn parameter)
mcp.read.no_turn: session {0} has no turn {1} ({2} turns total)
